definitions: The carrying out or putting into effect of a plan, order, or course of action.
The carrying out of a sentence of death on a condemned person.
The performance of an artistic work, a manoeuvre, or a skill.
The making or producing of a work of art.
examples: The execution of the project was flawless.
He was present at the execution.
Her execution of the piano piece was masterful.
The execution of the sculpture took months.
